# The creation time of a view, as BigQuery answers.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/information-schema-tables

# CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW gives the view a creation time of its own.
DECLARE created TIMESTAMP;
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.replaced_view_creation_time AS SELECT 1 AS x;
SET created = (SELECT creation_time FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE table_name = 'replaced_view_creation_time');
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.replaced_view_creation_time AS SELECT 2 AS x;
SELECT creation_time = created FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE table_name = 'replaced_view_creation_time'
=> "false"
